component.name: MergerFS Panel
component.summary: Manage disks and mergerfs pools with drag and drop

description.p: MergerFS Panel is a small GTK4 utility for managing mergerfs pools. The left panel lists the filesystems attached to the machine; the right panel lists the mergerfs pools that are currently mounted.

Drag a disk onto a pool to add it as a branch, or drag a pool or branch back onto the disks panel to unmount the pool or remove the branch. Branches are changed through mergerfs' live runtime interface, so open files on the pool are not interrupted.
Mounting and unmounting disks goes through UDisks2, with the usual polkit authentication. Pools are mounted as the current user, so no root helper is required.
